## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*World-Warning Merit-and-Demerit Ledger*

planchette-attributed *示定* (revealed-and-fixed) by [呂洞賓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%82%E6%B4%9E%E8%B3%93) (Lǚzǔ / Chúnyáng / Fúyòu shàngdì)

The companion merit-and-demerit ledger to [KR5i0095](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0095) *Shí jiè gōng guò gé*, organised topically by aspect of conduct (*qiú xīn* — seeking-the-mind; *cún xīn* — preserving-the-mind; *zhì xīn* — governing-the-mind) rather than by precept, and aimed more broadly at *jǐng shì* (warning the world) than at the initiate cohort. Pagination begins at sheet 58a, indicating continuous foliation with the preceding *Shí jiè gōng guò gé* — confirming that the two are pair-printed in the DZJY engraving.

**Abstract**

A Lǚ-zǔ-cult merit-and-demerit ledger in the *jǐng shì* (warning-the-world) register, paired with [KR5i0095](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0095) within the DZJY engraving. The work is more concerned with the *qiúxīn* / *cúnxīn* / *zhìxīn* heart-cultivation framework than with formal precept-keeping, and is more outward-facing — directed at the lay reader, not the initiate. Composition c. 1700–1809.
